h1: Do I need a building permit to remove an interior wall in Newton, MA?
title: Newton Interior Wall Removal Permits: Structural and Load-Bearing Work
description: Understand why removing a load-bearing wall is different from ordinary repairs and when structural plans may be needed.
short_answer: Removing or changing a load-bearing wall requires building-code review and a building permit when the work removes or changes structural support. The Massachusetts code specifically identifies removal or cutting of a structural beam or load-bearing support as work requiring a permit. Newton ISD should review the project plans before construction.

facts.text: The state code identifies substantial cutting of a wall or partition and removal or cutting of structural beams or load-bearing supports as work requiring a permit.
Newton ISD enforces the state building code and issues permits for regulated construction and alteration work.

qa.q: Can I remove a wall without checking whether it is load-bearing?
qa.a: Do not assume a wall is non-structural. Have the existing framing and proposed work evaluated and confirm permit requirements with Newton ISD before starting.
